functional_goal: Migrate the mathematical workflow, private vault, verifier, repair/finalization gates and project promotion to Rust without weakening L2 capability authority, verifier isolation, branch barriers, reference auditing, or the single mechanical finalizer.

components: deterministic workflow engine and transition validation
proof manifest and structured reference-audit enforcement
server-computed verifier verdict and compact/full repair escalation
private FinalizationPermit bound to verifier, LaTeX, proof and manifest facts
Python and Rust workflow shadow drivers

authority_types.CapabilityClaims: private fields, no external Deserialize, parser private to CapabilityAuthority
authority_types.FinalizationPermit: private fields, crate-private issue path, consumed only by crate-private vault finalizer

rollback: Do not compose mtm-workflow into deployed traffic; continue routing every production Rethlas workflow through Re-CTM Python. The Rust workflow has used only independent temporary/shadow state, so rollback requires no data migration.
